card: Solana devnet  ·  a program with no owner  ·  agentic payroll escrow
Encode Solana Hackathon  ·  Aurora Intents track  ·  November 2026
subs: A pharmacist on Sunday duty: hours the collective agreement pays extra.
Who proves the hours? A schedule, a badge log, an agreement thick as a phone book.
Every month someone chases a payment already earned. The worker carries the risk.
The AI agent reads the evidence. The code computes the amount, line by line, replayable: 466.57.
A human validates the statement. Nothing moves before that signature.
Who holds the money until payday? Not a safe, not us: a padlock on the line itself.
On Solana the padlock is a program with no owner: a derived address nobody has the key to.
The employer tries to take it back: refused, NotCancellable. Nobody can, not even him.
Before pressing, he reads the amount, the date and the payee. Those three are written in the escrow for good.
Locked on devnet, 31 October 2026. Finish before the date? Refused: TooEarly, recorded on chain.
The clock is the cluster's. When the date comes, anyone may finish; the money can only go where it was written.
